+# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+
+import inspect
+
+import pytest
+
+import attr
+
+
+def _base(slots, inherited):
+    if inherited:
+        @attr.define(slots=slots, frozen=True)
+        class Base:
+            pass
+    else:
+        Base = object
+    return Base
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("slots", [True, False])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("inherited", [True, False])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("generated_init", [True, False])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("default_kind", ["missing", "value", "factory"])
+def test_frozen_rejects_field_hook(slots, inherited, generated_init, default_kind):
+    events = []
+
+    def hook(inst, attribute, value):
+        events.append((inst, attribute.name, value))
+        return value
+
+    kwargs = {"init": False, "on_setattr": hook}
+    if default_kind == "value":
+        kwargs["default"] = 1
+    elif default_kind == "factory":
+        kwargs["factory"] = lambda: 1
+    base = _base(slots, inherited)
+
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="^Frozen classes can't use on_setattr[.]$"):
+        @attr.define(slots=slots, frozen=not inherited, init=generated_init)
+        class C(base):
+            delayed: int = attr.field(**kwargs)
+
+    assert events == []
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("slots", [True, False])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("inherited", [True, False])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("generated_init", [True, False])
+def test_frozen_no_op_preserves_initialization(slots, inherited, generated_init):
+    def forbidden(*args):
+        raise AssertionError("An omitted field callback ran during initialization")
+
+    base = _base(slots, inherited)
+
+    @attr.define(slots=slots, frozen=not inherited, init=generated_init)
+    class C(base):
+        marker: int = 7
+        delayed: int = attr.field(
+            init=False,
+            on_setattr=attr.setters.NO_OP,
+            converter=forbidden,
+            validator=forbidden,
+        )
+        defaulted: int = attr.field(init=False, default=11, on_setattr=attr.setters.NO_OP)
+        made: list = attr.field(init=False, factory=list, on_setattr=attr.setters.NO_OP)
+
+    c = C()
+    if not generated_init:
+        c.__attrs_init__()
+    assert c.marker == 7
+    assert not hasattr(c, "delayed")
+    assert c.defaulted == 11
+    assert c.made == []
+    initializer = C.__init__ if generated_init else C.__attrs_init__
+    assert "delayed" not in inspect.signature(initializer).parameters
+    with pytest.raises(attr.exceptions.FrozenInstanceError):
+        c.delayed = 5
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("slots", [True, False])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("generated_init", [True, False])
+def test_mutable_omitted_field_hook(slots, generated_init):
+    calls = []
+
+    def hook(inst, attribute, value):
+        calls.append((inst, attribute.name, value))
+        return value + 1
+
+    @attr.define(slots=slots, init=generated_init)
+    class C:
+        marker: int = 7
+        delayed: int = attr.field(init=False, on_setattr=hook)
+
+    c = C()
+    if not generated_init:
+        c.__attrs_init__()
+    assert c.marker == 7
+    assert not hasattr(c, "delayed")
+    assert calls == []
+    c.delayed = 4
+    assert c.delayed == 5
+    assert calls == [(c, "delayed", 4)]
+    assert attr.fields(C).delayed.init is False

spec.question:
Close a decoration-time validation gap in attrs' frozen-field contract. With attr.define, a field declared as init=False with neither a default nor a factory currently allows an explicit callable on_setattr hook even when the resulting class is frozen. Frozen classes must reject explicit field hooks other than setters.NO_OP with ValueError("Frozen classes can't use on_setattr."), regardless of whether the field participates in generated initialization. Apply the same rule when frozen status comes from a base class, for both slots=True and slots=False, and when define(init=False) generates __attrs_init__ instead of __init__.

Fields using setters.NO_OP must remain legal. Fields with init=False and no default or factory must remain uninitialized and absent from the generated initializer's parameters; their converters and validators must not run during initialization. Preserve initialization of defaulted and factory-backed fields, and preserve callable field hooks on mutable classes, including later assignment to an initially unset field. Return a unified diff against production files only, without changing tests.
